title: NINE MICE LIBERATED FROM A LABORATORY.
content:
19th September, New Orleans USA.







[editor’s note: whilst we have received text relating to the action, and it references extensive footage of the inside of the laboratory, we have not seen any of the footage and cannot confirm the validity of the report. No news press articles have been found at the time of writing. Image is unrelated, historical rabbit liberation image.]




received anonymously via email:




“The Animal Liberation Front claims responsibility for the liberation of nine mice from the University of New Orleans earlier this month.




On September 19, 2026, nine female mice (including four so-called “breeding females”) were loaded up and spirited away from a miserable, windowless cinderblock room on the 2nd floor of UNO’s Psychology Building to begin a new life in safety and comfort. All nine are being lovingly looked after and tended to. None were released into the wild.




The lab chosen was that of Christopher Harshaw, who subjects mice and rats to experiments that purportedly aim to study autism, body temperature regulation and social behavior. title: SEVERAL BEAGLES OPEN RESCUED AT MBR ACRES
content:
29th September, Cambridgeshire UK.










 According to Camp Beagle, people accessed MBR Acres on the 29th of September and liberated multiple dogs. At least three dogs were rescued, but there is potential of more dogs being liberated. One person stayed back after the raid and was arrested by the police.




 This event is ongoing, and we will update with more details when they become available.

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: LAMB LIBERATED FROM A FARM.
content:
September, Wales UK.




received anonymously via email:




“While walking through the Welsh countryside, we came across a couple of dead sheep before finding a young lamb who was unable to stand. They were severely malnourished and covered in ticks, clearly in desperate need of help.







We removed the ticks, carefully picked up the lamb and took them to a sanctuary where they could receive the care and protection they desperately needed.







Animal farmers are no different to human slave owners. Vegans need to keep exposing them for what they really are. Get active.”

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: GRASSROOTS MOVEMENT AUGUST ROUND UP
content:
There’s been some huge wins for the grassroots animal rights space in August.




Right at the start of the month, Southampton Animal Action convinced Brittany Ferries to end the live export of farmed animals from Ireland to France.




They protested and disrupted ports, offices, and shareholders across the South Coast and London for a year. Concerned the protests might escalate to demonstrations at sea, Brittany Ferries’ CEO gave them his personal WhatsApp number, arranged a series of meetings, and agreed to end the vile trade! The win has sent the Irish farming sector into crisis mode, and they are warning that if a replacement isn’t found soon. All eyes are now on Irish Ferries, the only remaining live exporter for the Irish farming industry. This is an incredible opportunity for our grassroots movement to strike a powerful blow against the dairy industry.




More incredible news from Scotland as grassroots activists and national organisation Protect the Wild have just saved 4,000 lives!




Following a sustained campaign against the Guga Hunt, which sees ten men from the Scottish island of Lewis bludgeon baby gannets to death for a local delicacy, the hunt’s licence has been revoked! title: TRAPS SMASHED, TOWERS TOPPLED AND PHEASANT PEN SABOTAGED.
content:
1st September, Bedfordshire UK.




received anonymously via email:







“On 1st September we took a visit to a known shooter’s land and wrecked his very large pheasant enclosure. There were numerous pheasants inside which would have undoubtedly be shot when the inbreds all met up for their blood thirsty session. It will take him time (and money) to build the enclosure again, by which time hopefully many of the pheasants will have left the area. A deer shooting tower was seen nearby and also dealt with.







A week prior to this we were alerted to a fox trap in a field behind another murderers house. When locating this we also came across a second trap in an adjacent field. Both traps were set and one had the carcus of a squirrel inside. Both traps were destroyed and taken away from the area.







We will be back to check on both locations regularly to ensure any further equipment is appropriately dealt with.”
